niche: the rate at which memory clinic patients' cognition declines, read from repeated ACE-III sittings whose second completed sitting is lifted by the patient having sat the test before, compared across clinics whose patients have sat it a median of two to five times because the clinics opened between 2014 and 2024
answer: The Research Committee should name Quarndale and Thurlwick as the recruiting sites for ARV-1102.
answer_source: task270/submission.md, block 1 (Final Recommendation); retired 2026-10-19, not shipped
analyst_test: A strong analyst who links each patient's sittings across the two record systems, keeps the completed ones, reads the paper's 3.1 (a change the test itself produces is not part of the rate) and sizes that change on the period's sittings, each patient's first sitting from 2022 taken as their first (1.24 points), files Thurlwick and Penwardine; the slope through every sitting files the same pair and dropping first sittings files Thurlwick and Mosswick; only the gain estimated over each patient's whole record, within patients (2.63), puts Quarndale, nearly all of whose patients have sat the test twice, in the pair.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each clinic's rate of cognitive decline, which neuropsychology estimates from serial testing net of the practice gain a repeated test carries at its first retest; in a field whose repeated readings learn nothing from being taken (a meter, a scale, a ledger balance) the second reading carries no gain, nothing separates a sitting's number from its time, and the task stops making sense.

world.geography: United Kingdom, England (a fictional NHS mental health trust)

driver: The decisive quantity is how fast each group's members lose a latent ability, read from repeated tests whose second sitting is lifted by the member having sat the test before; a slope through every sitting flattens most for the groups whose members have sat it only a few times, so those groups look slower than they are, and only separating the one-time gain of the second sitting from the trend puts the groups in their true order.
driver_concrete: Each memory clinic's average decline in ACE-III points a year over 2022 to September 2026, net of the change the test itself produces, which is the gain a patient's second completed sitting of their whole record carries, estimated within patients across all clinics; sized on the period's sittings alone it is diluted by the patients first assessed before 2022, and a slope through every sitting, per patient or in a random-slopes model, keeps it in, so both leave Quarndale, nearly all of whose patients have sat the test twice, outside the pair and name Thurlwick and Penwardine.
stump: A competent solver who reads the paper's 3.1 sizes the change the test itself produces on the period's sittings, each patient's first completed sitting from 2022 taken as their first (1.24 points), and files Thurlwick and Penwardine as the two fastest-declining clinics, Penwardine in place of Quarndale, because the gain belongs to each patient's whole record: patients first assessed before 2022 carry it through every sitting in the period, which dilutes a step read inside the period to half its size, while Quarndale, opened in April 2024 with nearly all of its patients at two sittings, stays sixth. Only the gain estimated over each patient's whole record, within patients (2.63), netted from every patient's slope puts Quarndale in the pair.

differentiation.task451: task451 v1 credited spending through commingled intermediaries by the inflow mix each held when it paid out; this build separates a one-time gain that a test's second sitting carries from a person's trend in a measured ability, a measurement process with no money, no intermediaries and no inflow shares.
differentiation.task270: architectures 1 and 2 recovered a quantity hidden by selection (appointment on a composite) and by events never recorded (claims absorbed below a cost); here every sitting is recorded and nobody is selected out, and the second completed sitting carries a one-time gain from the test's own repetition, separated as a step beside each patient's trend
differentiation.task262: task262 removes transitory noise around a persistent level from single-year readings, a reliability correction; here the reading carries a systematic one-time gain tied to the sitting's number, separated as a step beside each patient's trend, and no reliability ratio enters
differentiation.task268: task268 carries each patient the registry lost from the heart failure class recorded at the loss, informative censoring in a survival estimate; here no patient is lost and every sitting is recorded, and the decisive step separates a one-time gain tied to a test's own repetition from each patient's trend
differentiation.task269: task269's third architecture measures each rider's excess wait over the departures serving their own destination, whose wait counts against which buses; here the slate is ranked on a growth rate read from repeated tests, and the decisive step separates a measurement gain from each patient's trend
differentiation.task194: task194 develops the recent periods' complication counts by a coding lag two vintages of the series measure; here the records are final, and the correction is a one-time gain tied to the sitting's number, estimated within patients

lineage.niche: the predictive validity of a civil-service police entry examination's components across the candidate pool, estimated from an academy outcome that exists only for the candidates appointed in rank order of two of the components
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how strongly each of several measures predicts an outcome across a whole pool when the outcome exists only for the members picked from the pool in rank order of a weighted sum of two of the measures; the correlations among those picked understate every measure, and correcting each measure as if it alone had picked them leaves the two that formed the sum understated, so only a correction that models the pick on the sum, with the measures' spread across the whole pool, restores which measures predict best.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each examination component's correlation with the police academy's final average across everyone who sat the 2024 and 2025 examinations, recovered from the appointees' grades by the multivariate correction on the written test, the oral board, the veterans' credit and the physical ability test's points the appointments were made on; the appointees' own correlations and a per-component Case II correction both leave the written test and the oral board looking weaker than they are and keep the work style inventory.
lineage.stump: A competent solver correlates each component with the academy final average among the appointees, or corrects each correlation separately by Case II, and keeps the written test and the work style inventory, because the appointments were made in rank order of the written test and oral board composite, which restricted those two (and the oral board most, beside the written test it was ranked with) far more than the per-component spreads show.
lineage.answer: The 2027 entry examination should keep the written test and the oral board.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 (Gate F): both isolated scored readers landed the call, the order and the first component below; reader 1 applied the multivariate correction for selection on the variables the appointments were ranked on (Lawley) from the filed rules and the plan's pool, reader 2 the same correction; reader 1 also landed all five costs (5 of 14 ask figures), reader 2 all 14; the judge DETERMINISTIC, APPROVE. A filed selection rule plus a filed population of appointees and non-appointees hands a strong reader the textbook correction.

lineage.niche: a no-claims step scale makes an at-fault claim cost a policyholder future premium that depends on the step they stand on, so drivers on the middle steps pay small damage themselves; the frequency a region will show once the 2027 wording removes that cost is recovered from the claims nobody absorbs and the size distribution of the policyholders for whom a claim already costs nothing
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how often each group's members will report an event once reporting costs them nothing, when today each member absorbs events smaller than what reporting would cost them and that cost rises and falls with their position on a scale, so the reported count understates most the groups whose members stand where reporting costs most; counting only the events too large for anyone to absorb, scaled by how common events that large are among members for whom reporting already costs nothing, recovers it, while a group that buys out the cost is self-selected and gives the size of events, not their rate.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each region's claims per 100 vehicle-years under the 2027 protected wording, recovered step by step from the at-fault claims above the size no policyholder absorbs, scaled by the share of claims that large among step-0 policyholders and Step Protection holders, plus the not-at-fault claims everyone already makes; the reported frequency and a lift taken from the Step Protection holders' frequency on steps 6 to 9 leave the middle-step regions understated.
lineage.stump: A competent solver ranks the regions by their 2024 and 2025 reported claim frequency (or lifts steps 6 to 9 by the Step Protection holders' frequency) and files band C as South East, West Midlands and Yorkshire and the Humber, South East in place of North West, because North West's policyholders stand mostly on the middle steps with the book's highest premiums, where a claim costs the most premium over the climb back, and pay small at-fault damage themselves, so North West reports the smallest share of its accidents while South East, on the top steps and under Step Protection, reports nearly all of its own.
lineage.answer: Band C of the 2027 rating basis holds North West, West Midlands and Yorkshire and the Humber; South East is the first region below.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 (Gate F): reader 6 of six isolated scored readers took the claims above 2,500 pounds as fully reported and scaled them by the protected policies' share above that size, landing the call and the first region below; readers 1 to 5 filed the reported or uplifted band; reader 5 took all 32 ask figures. Section 2.1's counterfactual wording says a correction is owed, and claim sizes by step show where the scale stops mattering, so the recovery is reachable for a strong reader.
